{
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid)
    obs={}
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v: obs[(c-r)%n]=v
    # find the smallest period compatible with all observed anti-diagonals
    p=next(p for p in range(1,n+1) if all(obs[a]==obs[b] for a in obs for b in obs if a%p==b%p))
    seq=[None]*p
    for a,v in obs.items(): seq[a%p]=v
    # Fill unseen positions by finding color runs along the cyclic sequence,
    # selecting the shortest periodic completion consistent with observed stripes.
    # These diagonal stripe tasks use a motif repeated across the entire canvas.
    # Enumerate candidates over colors seen, favoring run-length compact motifs.
    colors=sorted(set(obs.values()))
    import itertools
    missing=[i for i,x in enumerate(seq) if x is None]
    if missing:
        # Choose values for holes minimizing transitions and using observed patterns.
        best=None
        for vals in itertools.product(colors, repeat=len(missing)):
            q=seq[:]
            for i,v in zip(missing,vals): q[i]=v
            score=sum(q[i]!=q[(i+1)%p] for i in range(p))
            if best is None or score<best[0]: best=(score,q)
        seq=best[1]
    return [[seq[(c-r)%p] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
